design_philosophy: E1 'Control Room' Dashboard: A brutally efficient, cardless design that prioritizes data hierarchy through a dense, 1px seamless grid. We abandon generic soft drop-shadows and rounded corners in favor of absolute clarity, employing sharp edges, 'Technical Look' grid borders, and radical typography weight contrast. The AI Sales Forecast uses a terminal-inspired dark module to create visual tension against the crisp white canvas.

typography.metric_number: text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-zinc-950
typography.font_installation: Use Google Fonts for IBM Plex Sans & IBM Plex Mono. Use Fontshare API or local asset for Cabinet Grotesk.

layout.grid_system: The 'Control Room' Grid (Gapless). Use a parent with 'grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 border-t border-l border-zinc-200'. All children must have 'border-r border-b border-zinc-200' and 'bg-white' or 'bg-zinc-50'.
layout.spacing_scale: Dense internal padding for widgets: p-6 or p-8. No rounded corners except for specific internal badges (max rounded-sm).

stats_cards.style: Cardless grid item. Left-aligned metric label (mono), massive metric number below it. Minimalist 1px SVG sparkline anchored to the bottom right of the cell.

ai_sales_forecast.style: Retro-Futuristic Terminal block. bg-zinc-950 text-[#00FF41] font-mono p-6. Displays predicted revenue and AI insights. Creates high contrast on the dashboard.

financial_summary.style: Area chart spanning large width. Use Recharts. Hide all axes lines except horizontal dashed grids. Chart line color: #002FA7. Chart fill: gentle gradient of #002FA7 to transparent.

annual_goal_progress.style: Segmented brutalist progress bar. Instead of one continuous bar, use 10 separate rectangular blocks (e.g., 7 filled with #002FA7, 3 empty/gray).

calendar_upcoming_visits.style: Dense, technical list. Time displayed in IBM Plex Mono. Rows separated by 1px borders. Use hover state: hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-950.

top_customers.style: Avatar list with absolute precision. Use sharp square avatars or purely typographic initials [AB]. Include revenue aligned right in Mono font.

sidebar_navigation.style: Left sidebar. 1px right border. Extremely clean, monochrome icons (Phosphor Icons). Active state indicated by a bold 2px left border in #002FA7, not a background blob.

motion_interactions.hover_states: Interactive rows (customers, visits) change background from white to zinc-100 instantly. Fast, mechanical feel.

icons.style: Regular or Light weight. No duotone for dashboards.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, metric cards, and charts MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='metric-total-customers', data-testid='btn-add-visit'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text contrast must meet APCA standards. Black/Dark Gray text on White/Zinc-50 background.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Shadcn's default Card component with shadows and rounded corners. Build raw divs with `border-r border-b border-zinc-200` to create a seamless, gapless 'Technical Look' grid.
Install and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Use 'IBM Plex Mono' for all numbers, metrics, and timestamps.
Implement the 'AI Sales Forecast' as a distinct, retro-futuristic dark module (bg-zinc-950, text-[#00FF41]) to stand out against the white dashboard.
For the Financial Summary, use Recharts to build an Area Chart. Use strict, minimalist styling: no vertical grid lines, no axis lines, only subtle dashed horizontal lines.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for all iconography.
Ensure the layout is responsive, stacking cleanly on mobile while preserving the 1px border aesthetic.
Translate all requested metrics and headers into Turkish (e.g., 'Toplam Müşteri', 'Finansal Özet', 'Yıllık Hedef', 'Yaklaşan Ziyaretler').
Wrap grid layouts with 'border-t border-l border-zinc-200' while children have 'border-r border-b border-zinc-200' to create the technical border matrix.
